# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face and sparkling black eyes. He carries himself with an impertinent swagger.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Sullen, mischievous, and impertinent, Anthony holds female teachers in contempt and resists attempts to win his affection. He behaves with mockery, scornful bravado, and a swaggering air of toleration when obeying orders.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)_

- sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye was taken in as an orphan nephew by Mrs. George Pye and her husband. Upon moving to Avonlea, he began attending the local school taught by Anne Shirley. He immediately took a dislike to Anne, maintaining that she was no good like all female teachers. During his school days, he engaged in pranks, such as pouring slate-bottle water down Aurelia Clay's neck and placing a live mouse in Anne's desk drawer. After remaining unaffected by Anne's lectures about being a gentleman, his defiance eventually cracked when Anne punished him with a pointer, causing his bravado to fail and bringing tears to his eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)_
